notes.title: Free DLC Game Released
notes.content:
This DLC includes spoilers!
It is recommended that you complete the base game "Hospital 9" before playing this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1417100/

It's a short first-person adventure game.
Look for "investigation zone" in the building.
Answer the quiz about the object there.
If you answer all the quizzes correctly, you win the game.

You can select a game by pressing "Play" in the STEAM application.
I hope you enjoy the aftertaste of the story.

notes.title: About Free DLC Game
notes.content:
There is currently a plan to add the free DLC game to this game.
It might be something like a mini game.
Don't hold your breath please.
(This announcement is not a promise to the DLC release.)

notes.title: Light version, version down
notes.content: A translation defect was found in the light version 1.01, so it was returned to the light version 1.00.

notes.title: Light version
notes.content:
A light version has been released. 
The forest level and some objects have been cut.
The light version installation requires 4 GB of storage.
Right click on the game name in the Steam app and press Properties.
Select light-version from the drop down list on the Beta tab. 
To undo, select "None. not participate in any beta".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35861805/881627750fd135c3151da604fa9a5b6430ddee3e.png[/img]
